summary: Iteration 7 (Inventory Groups) testing. Found + fixed a CRITICAL blocking bug in backend Pydantic models (CostumeCreate/CostumeUpdate were missing group_id + variant_label fields, causing ALL POST /api/costumes to return 500). After fix: 20/20 backend tests pass (including new Iteration 7 group flow tests). Frontend verified end-to-end via Playwright: Inventory H1 = 'Inventory', groups strip renders, New Group prompt→create→navigate flow works, Group detail shows variant_count/total_items, group delete works, form-group + form-variant-label present (variant label correctly disabled when no group), Storage nav label correct, Settings uses 'Locations' / 'Add location' wording, and back-link on /costume/:id uses history navigation (returns to /inventory when arriving from /inventory).
action_items: None — all Iteration 7 items in the review request verified working after the model-field fix.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by testing agent: CostumeCreate (extends CostumeBase) and CostumeUpdate in /app/backend/server.py did not declare group_id/variant_label, but create_costume/update_costume referenced payload.group_id — resulted in AttributeError → 500 on every costume create and silent drop of group assignment on PUT. Added the fields to CostumeBase and CostumeUpdate. Please review the fix.
server.py is ~1118 lines — consider splitting into routers/*.py modules (costumes, groups, locations, categories, shows, settings, upload) for maintainability.

Group deletion resets variant_label to '' — good. But GET /api/groups does not include total_items in the list endpoint (only variant_count). List detail endpoint adds it. Minor inconsistency vs. /api/inventory.
/api/inventory does an N+1 query pattern (one costumes.find per group). Fine at current scale but worth noting.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (added group_id + variant_label to CostumeBase and CostumeUpdate)
seed_data_creation: Tests use TEST_ prefix; all created data cleaned up after run. Dev-seeded '4-Color Earring Set' group left intact as requested.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 shipped Inventory Groups. Backend Pydantic models needed group_id/variant_label added to CostumeBase & CostumeUpdate — that fix is applied. Group endpoints live at /api/groups, mixed feed at /api/inventory. GroupDetail page at /group/:id. Back-link on CostumeDetail now uses navigate(-1).
rca of the issue: AttributeError: 'CostumeCreate' object has no attribute 'group_id'. Root cause: developer added group_id/variant_label to the Costume response model and to the create_costume handler body but forgot to add them to CostumeBase (which CostumeCreate extends) and CostumeUpdate. Pydantic v2 does not attach undeclared extras as attributes when extra='ignore'/default. Mitigation applied: added Optional[str] group_id and Optional[str] variant_label to CostumeBase and CostumeUpdate. Verified via full CRUD + group flow tests.
